module.title: Inpatient
module.description: Admitted patients: wards and beds, admission with an advance, the bed board, bed moves, daily bed charges on the bill, rounds, nursing notes and discharge.

board.title: Bed board
board.text: Every bed by ward. Tap an occupied bed to open the patient, a free one to admit, a cleaned one to mark it ready.
board.no_beds: No beds in this ward yet.
board.empty_text: Add wards and cabins, then their beds.

admit.title: Admit a patient
admit.text: Find the patient, pick the doctor and a free bed, take the advance, then admit.
admit.no_patient: No patient found. Check the spelling or register them.
admit.take_advance: Take the advance in Patient billing

admissions.title: Admitted patients
admissions.text: Patients in the hospital now, with bed, doctor and days so far.

admission.move_text: The days so far stay at the old bed; the old bed goes for cleaning.
admission.cancel_text: Only for a mistake: its bed days come off the open bill and the bed goes for cleaning.

beds.title: Beds
beds.text: Each ward's beds and their daily charge (a service in Patient billing).
beds.service_hint: A service code from "Services and prices" in Patient billing.
beds.remove_text: Only a bed that never had a patient can be removed; others are switched off.
beds.no_wards: Add a ward or cabin first (Wards and cabins).

admit.title: How to admit a patient

steps.2: Pick doctor, ward and a free bed.

tips.1: The first bed day goes on the bill at once; the next ones by themselves each day.

admit.settings: When a bed day starts and the advance needed are in the Inpatient settings.

steps.1: Green = free, red = occupied, amber = cleaning, grey = blocked; each also says it in words.
steps.2: Tap a bed to open the patient.

tips.1: A bed being cleaned: tap it when it is ready.

steps.3: Open the bill to take money.

tips.1: Rounds, nursing notes and discharge come in the next update.

wards.title: How to set up wards and beds

steps.2: Add beds with their daily charge.

tips.1: The daily charge is a service in "Services and prices" (Patient billing).
